events.context: User asks how to delete Claude auth logout info without deleting skills/agent settings
System provides multiple methods to safely delete auth.json: ls directories, rm ~/.config/claude/auth.json, find commands, backup methods, recommends claude auth logout
User runs: find ~/.config -path '*/claude/*auth*' -type f -delete 2>/dev/null; find ~/Library -path '*/claude/*auth*' -type f -delete 2>/dev/null
User runs: ls -la ~/.config/claude/skills/ → returns 'No such file or directory' indicating entire claude directory deleted
System identifies problem: find command pattern '*/claude/*auth*' accidentally deleted entire ~/.config/claude/ directory due to flat structure
System provides recovery steps: check backups, Time Machine, Trash, use TestDisk/PhotoRec, or recreate directories
User shows partial claude.json content with config settings like numStartups, theme, tipsHistory, cachedGrowthBookFeatures
